description: Golden question set for the SourceWise sample corpus (63 questions: 51 answerable, 12 unanswerable). Questions are phrased the way a member of staff would ask them, not copied from the documents. 'expected' names the document and section that contain the answer. 'answer_contains' lists short strings; a correct answer must include at least one of them (several are listed only where the same fact is worded differently in two documents). Questions with answerable=false are not covered by the corpus and should be abstained on. This file was written and frozen before the abstention rule was redesigned and was not used for tuning; see eval/README.md.
